name: Zacess Light
description: Ink on white, the reader's Dark on light theme.
toml:
# the Zacess Light theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Light"
id = "zacess-light"
description = "Ink on white, the reader's Dark on light theme."
appearance = "light"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#ffffff"
foreground = "#111111"
surface = "#f4f4f4"
surface_alt = "#ededed"
muted = "#424242"
border = "#707070"
accent = "#0049a3"
accent_foreground = "#ffffff"
link = "#0049a3"
focus_ring = "#0049a3"
cursor = "#111111"
cursor_text = "#ffffff"
selection_background = "#0150b2"
selection_foreground = "#ffffff"
selection_soft = "#9bc3ff"
line_highlight = "#d6dde8"
error = "#810005"
# was #583600, which matched the error colour in tone and merged with it under simulated colour
# vision deficiencies; this burnt orange is the most colourful shade that keeps them apart at 7:1
warning = "#843800"
info = "#003a84"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#59029f"
control = "#5e003c"
function = "#0049a3"
type = "#003737"
variable = "#111111"
parameter = "#4c2300"
property = "#030075"
string = "#004a0e"
number = "#4c1b00"
comment = "#97016b"
operator = "#111111"
tag = "#59029f"
attribute = "#412300"
regex = "#5b0020"
invalid = "#5d0002"
added = "#005b14"
removed = "#5d0002"
changed = "#001940"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#111111", "#ca010e", "#01751c", "#885a00",
    "#005fcc", "#b301ae", "#026f6f", "#484848",
    "#4d4d4d", "#e90112", "#008722", "#9d6902",
    "#006eed", "#cf01c7", "#028181", "#111111",
]
dim = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-light.toml (Zacess Light)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest warning #843800 on surface_alt #ededed: 7.04:1
